opening.argument: The speaker presents a business opportunity built around referral recruitment, account funding, and expanding teams. Viewers are told that sharing a referral link means they intend to “build a team,” while referred members who have not funded their accounts should be introduced to Bitcoin and assisted with funding. The presentation also shows a branching member structure with left and right teams, and encourages members to guide recruits in building teams of their own. This growth is framed as the vehicle to “financial freedom,” and viewers seeking more information are directed to the person who sent the video, establishing an active recruitment and money-flow solicitation rather than reporting or criticism.

citations.quote: If you are giving out your referral link, this means you intend to build a team.
Assist them with funding their account, answer any questions they may have, and forward any information they need.
Remember, this is your opportunity to build a business that will be the vehicle that gets you to the land of financial freedom.
For more information please contact the person who sent you this video.
